summary.text: J.T. Payne is a Republican state representative who has represented Kentucky House of Representatives District 11 since 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former educator and school administrator, he earned his degrees at Murray State University.

paragraphs.text: J.T. Payne earned a B.S. in agriculture science, an M.A. in teacher leadership, and an M.A. in education administration from Murray State University.
His career experience includes working as an educator and school administrator.
He took office in the Kentucky House on January 1, 2025, as the successor to Jonathan Dixon.
For 2025-2026 he was assigned to the House Agriculture, Economic Development and Workforce Investment, and Postsecondary Education committees.
He faces Democrat Janelle Rowena Glass in the general election.
